exact_missing_items: Canonical event families must be shared between the runtime and UI projections — the Orchestrator must NOT invent a shadow event language separate from the runtime event model
Multi-account control-loop scope applies to ALL provider-using actors: assistant, interviewer, requirements-doc builder, overseers, node workers, delegated workers — no actor is exempt
Each failed node attempt must leave a structured receipt/handoff artifact containing: what it did, what changed, why failed, what to try next — this is mandatory, not optional
Canonical handoff/retry memory must be stored as structured runtime records NOT loose markdown; worker-facing handoff = synthesized bounded packet derived from canonical records

'attempt' object required fields: identity, actor type, requested vs effective provider/model/effort/persona/account, resolution/fallback metadata, lane/snapshot linkage, lifecycle/result, evidence refs

Attempt handoff artifact must include these 8 fields: what was attempted, what changed/artifacts produced, checks/tests/review outcome, why failed/blocked, contamination/restore state, recommended next action, reusable learnings/patterns, retry budget consumed
Corroboration rule: 2-of-3 quorum required before accepting high-impact overseer claims as canonical; failure to reach 2-of-3 still emits a non-blocking advisory even without quorum
Seam review outputs must include: verdict, failure classes with severity, evidence bundle/rationale, remediation-node or graph-patch recommendation, corroboration requirement and outcome
Issue classes requiring corroboration (5): missing wiring, implementation quality concerns, unmet intent despite passing tests, missing spec/hidden dependency, graph structure insufficiency
`Plans/Contracts_V0.md` and `Plans/Executor_Protocol.md` already carry `startup_recovered` in runtime wake canon.
